tvCategories.title: Manage TV Channel Categories
tvCategories.description: Keep the default categories and extend them with your own labels. Categories in use cannot be removed.
tvCategories.inputPlaceholder: Create a custom category (e.g. Premium Sports)
tvCategories.none: You have not created any custom categories yet.
tvCategories.removeDescription: This action cannot be undone. The category "{{name}}" will be removed.
tvCategories.helpText: Default categories stay pinned at the top. Custom labels help you organize providers or regions however you need.
tvCategories.protectionNote: Categories in use are protected to avoid accidental removal.
